sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_189579_vtrack.FleetService</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Vehicle Tracking: FleetService</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>FleetService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var FleetService = Class.create();
FleetService.prototype = {
  initialize: function() { this.V = 'x_189579_vtrack_vehicle'; this.T = 'x_189579_vtrack_trip'; },
  _openCounts: function() {
    var c = {}, ga = new GlideAggregate('incident');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addQuery('cmdb_ci.sys_class_name', this.V);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.groupBy('cmdb_ci');
    ga.query();
    while (ga.next()) c[ga.getValue('cmdb_ci')] = parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10);
    return c;
  },
  _openIncidents: function() {
    var m = {}, g = new GlideRecord('incident');
    g.addQuery('active', true);
    g.addQuery('cmdb_ci.sys_class_name', this.V);
    g.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    g.query();
    while (g.next()) { var ci = g.getValue('cmdb_ci'); (m[ci] = m[ci] || []).push({ sys_id: g.getUniqueValue(), number: g.getValue('number'), short_description: g.getValue('short_description') }); }
    return m;
  },
  listVehicles: function(road, q) {
    var counts = {}, incs = this._openIncidents(), out = [];
    for (var k in incs) counts[k] = incs[k].length;
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.V);
    if (road) gr.addQuery('road', road);
    if (q) gr.addEncodedQuery('vehicle_numberLIKE' + q + '^ORvehicle_idLIKE' + q + '^ORroadLIKE' + q);
    gr.orderBy('vehicle_number');
    gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) {
      var id = gr.getUniqueValue();
      out.push({
        sys_id: id, vehicle_id: gr.getValue('vehicle_id'), number: gr.getValue('vehicle_number'),
        road: gr.getValue('road'), lat: parseFloat(gr.getValue('latitude')), lng: parseFloat(gr.getValue('longitude')),
        speed: parseInt(gr.getValue('speed'), 10) || 0, heading: parseInt(gr.getValue('heading'), 10) || 0,
        status: gr.getValue('vehicle_status'), last_seen: gr.getDisplayValue('last_seen'), source: gr.getValue('data_source'),
        open_incidents: counts[id] || 0, incidents: incs[id] || []
      });
    }
    return { vehicles: out, count: out.length, as_of: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue() };
  },
  roads: function() {
    var out = [], seen = {}, R = FleetSimulator.ROADS;
    for (var i = 0; i < R.length; i++) { out.push({ name: R[i].name, path: R[i].path }); seen[R[i].name] = true; }
    var ga = new GlideAggregate(this.V);
    ga.groupBy('road'); ga.query();
    while (ga.next()) { var n = ga.getValue('road'); if (n && !seen[n]) { out.push({ name: n, path: [] }); seen[n] = true; } }
    return { roads: out };
  },
  createIncident: function(vehicleId, data) {
    data = data || {};
    var v = new GlideRecord(this.V);
    if (!v.get('vehicle_id', vehicleId)) return { error: 'Vehicle ' + vehicleId + ' not found' };
    var inc = new GlideRecord('incident');
    inc.initialize();
    inc.setValue('cmdb_ci', v.getUniqueValue());
    inc.setValue('caller_id', gs.getUserID());
    inc.setValue('short_description', data.short_description ? '' + data.short_description : 'Issue reported on vehicle ' + v.getValue('vehicle_number'));
    inc.setValue('description', (data.description ? data.description + '\n\n' : '') +
      'Vehicle: ' + v.getValue('vehicle_number') + ' (' + v.getValue('vehicle_id') + ')\n' +
      'Road: ' + v.getValue('road') + '\n' +
      'Position: ' + v.getValue('latitude') + ', ' + v.getValue('longitude') + '\n' +
      'Speed: ' + v.getValue('speed') + ' mph, status ' + v.getValue('vehicle_status') + '\n' +
      'Last seen: ' + v.getDisplayValue('last_seen'));
    var u = parseInt(data.urgency, 10);
    if (u >= 1 && u <= 3) { inc.setValue('urgency', u); inc.setValue('impact', u); }
    inc.setValue('contact_type', 'self-service');
    var id = inc.insert();
    if (!id) return { error: 'Incident insert failed' };
    return { sys_id: id, number: inc.getValue('number'), vehicle: v.getValue('vehicle_number'), url: '/incident.do?sys_id=' + id };
  },
  trips: function(vehicleId) {
    var out = [], t = new GlideRecord(this.T);
    t.addQuery('vehicle.vehicle_id', vehicleId);
    t.orderByDesc('started'); t.setLimit(20); t.query();
    while (t.next()) out.push({ from_road: t.getValue('from_road'), to_road: t.getValue('to_road'), started: t.getDisplayValue('started'), lat: parseFloat(t.getValue('latitude')), lng: parseFloat(t.getValue('longitude')) });
    return { trips: out };
  },
  type: 'FleetService'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-15 20:03:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>e2929284c3cc1fd014d3b91ed4013194</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FleetService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vehicle Tracking" source="x_189579_vtrack">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicle Tracking">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e2929284c3cc1fd014d3b91ed4013194</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-15 20:24:31</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sc_req_item</collection><condition>current.cat_item == 'a4b39648c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131e9'</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Vehicle Tracking - Create incident from </name><order>500</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
  var vehicleId = '' + current.variables.vehicle;
  if (!vehicleId) return;
  var v = new GlideRecord('x_189579_vtrack_vehicle');
  if (!v.get(vehicleId)) return;
  var inc = new GlideRecord('incident');
  inc.initialize();
  inc.setValue('cmdb_ci', vehicleId);
  inc.setValue('caller_id', '' + (current.variables.requested_for || current.requested_for || gs.getUserID()));
  inc.setValue('short_description', 'Vehicle issue: ' + v.getValue('vehicle_number') + ' - ' + current.variables.issue_summary);
  inc.setValue('description', current.variables.issue_details + '\n\nRequested for: ' + current.variables.requested_for.getDisplayValue() +
    '\nRequested by: ' + current.variables.requested_by.getDisplayValue() + '\nVehicle: ' + v.getValue('vehicle_number') + ' (' + v.getValue('vehicle_id') + ') on ' + v.getValue('road') +
    '\nFrom catalog request: ' + current.getValue('number'));
  var u = parseInt('' + current.variables.urgency, 10);
  if (u >= 1 && u <= 3) { inc.setValue('urgency', u); inc.setValue('impact', u); }
  inc.setValue('parent', current.getUniqueValue());
  inc.setValue('contact_type', 'self-service');
  inc.insert();
  gs.info('Vehicle Tracking: ' + current.getValue('number') + ' created incident ' + inc.getValue('number'));
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-15 20:08:51</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8ab31a48c3cc1fd014d3b91ed4013196</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Vehicle Tracking - Create incident from </sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Vehicle Tracking" source="x_189579_vtrack">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicle Tracking">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_8ab31a48c3cc1fd014d3b91ed4013196</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-15 20:08:51</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=8ab31a48c3cc1fd014d3b91ed4013196"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_189579_vtrack.VehicleSync</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Vehicle Tracking: VehicleSync</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>VehicleSync</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var VehicleSync = Class.create();
VehicleSync.prototype = {
  initialize: function() {
    this.P = 'x_189579_vtrack.';
    this.V = 'x_189579_vtrack_vehicle';
    this.T = 'x_189579_vtrack_trip';
  },
  sync: function() {
    var url = gs.getProperty(this.P + 'api_url', '');
    var size = parseInt(gs.getProperty(this.P + 'page_size', '20'), 10) || 20;
    var map = {};
    try { map = JSON.parse(gs.getProperty(this.P + 'field_map', '{}')); } catch (e) {}
    var offset = 0, pages = 0, count = 0, created = 0, trips = 0, errors = [];
    while (pages < 500) {
      var page;
      try { page = url ? this._fetchRemote(url, offset, size) : new FleetSimulator().getPage(offset, size); }
      catch (ex) { errors.push('' + ex); break; }
      var rows = page.results || [];
      pages++;
      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var r = this._upsert(this._map(rows[i], map), url ? 'Live API' : 'Simulator');
        count++; if (r.created) created++; if (r.trip) trips++;
      }
      if (!rows.length) break;
      if (page.next === null) break;
      if (typeof page.next === 'number') offset = page.next;
      else { if (rows.length < size) break; offset += size; }
    }
    var res = { source: url ? 'Live API' : 'Simulator', pages: pages, vehicles: count, created: created, trips: trips, errors: errors };
    gs.info('VehicleSync ' + JSON.stringify(res));
    return res;
  },
  _fetchRemote: function(url, offset, size) {
    var rm = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
    rm.setEndpoint(url); rm.setHttpMethod('get'); rm.setHttpTimeout(30000);
    rm.setQueryParameter(gs.getProperty(this.P + 'limit_param', 'limit'), '' + size);
    rm.setQueryParameter(gs.getProperty(this.P + 'offset_param', 'offset'), '' + offset);
    rm.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
    var h = gs.getProperty(this.P + 'api_key_header', '');
    if (h) rm.setRequestHeader(h, gs.getProperty(this.P + 'api_key', ''));
    var resp = rm.execute();
    if (resp.getStatusCode() >= 300) throw 'HTTP ' + resp.getStatusCode() + ': ' + resp.getBody();
    var body = JSON.parse(resp.getBody());
    var path = gs.getProperty(this.P + 'results_path', 'results');
    var rows = Array.isArray(body) ? body : this._get(body, path);
    return { results: rows || [], next: (typeof body.next === 'number' || body.next === null) ? body.next : undefined };
  },
  _get: function(o, path) {
    if (!path) return o;
    var parts = path.split('.');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) { if (o === null || o === undefined) return undefined; o = o[parts[i]]; }
    return o;
  },
  _map: function(row, map) {
    var keys = ['id', 'number', 'lat', 'lng', 'road', 'speed', 'heading', 'status'], v = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) v[keys[i]] = this._get(row, map[keys[i]] || keys[i]);
    v.trip = row.trip;
    return v;
  },
  _upsert: function(v, source) {
    if (!v.id) return {};
    var gr = new GlideRecord(this.V);
    gr.addQuery('vehicle_id', '' + v.id); gr.setLimit(1); gr.query();
    var created = false, prevRoad = '';
    if (gr.next()) prevRoad = gr.getValue('road') || '';
    else { gr.initialize(); gr.setValue('vehicle_id', '' + v.id); created = true; }
    gr.setValue('name', '' + (v.number || v.id));
    gr.setValue('vehicle_number', '' + (v.number || ''));
    gr.setValue('road', '' + (v.road || ''));
    gr.setValue('latitude', '' + v.lat);
    gr.setValue('longitude', '' + v.lng);
    gr.setValue('speed', parseInt(v.speed, 10) || 0);
    gr.setValue('heading', parseInt(v.heading, 10) || 0);
    gr.setValue('vehicle_status', '' + (v.status || ''));
    gr.setValue('last_seen', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
    gr.setValue('data_source', source);
    var id = created ? gr.insert() : (gr.update(), gr.getUniqueValue());
    var trip = false;
    if (!created && v.road && prevRoad && prevRoad != v.road) {
      var t = new GlideRecord(this.T);
      t.initialize();
      t.setValue('vehicle', id);
      t.setValue('trip_id', v.trip && v.trip.id ? '' + v.trip.id : '');
      t.setValue('from_road', prevRoad);
      t.setValue('to_road', '' + v.road);
      t.setValue('started', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
      t.setValue('latitude', '' + v.lat);
      t.setValue('longitude', '' + v.lng);
      t.insert();
      trip = true;
    }
    return { created: created, trip: trip, sys_id: id };
  },
  type: 'VehicleSync'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-15 20:03:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>22929284c3cc1fd014d3b91ed401318f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>VehicleSync</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vehicle Tracking" source="x_189579_vtrack">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicle Tracking">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_22929284c3cc1fd014d3b91ed401318f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-15 20:03:58</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

];
FleetSimulator.TOTAL = 45;
FleetSimulator.prototype = {
  initialize: function() {},
  _pad: function(n) { var s = '' + n; while (s.length < 3) s = '0' + s; return s; },
  _point: function(path, f) {
    var segs = path.length - 1, x = f * segs, i = Math.min(Math.floor(x), segs - 1), t = x - i;
    var a = path[i], b = path[i + 1];
    var lat = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, lng = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t;
    var hd = Math.round((Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]) * 180 / Math.PI + 360) % 360);
    return { lat: lat, lng: lng, heading: hd };
  },
  vehicle: function(i, nowSec) {
    var R = FleetSimulator.ROADS, P = 180 + (i % 5) * 30;
    var phase = (nowSec + i * 37) / P, leg = Math.floor(phase), frac = phase - leg;
    var road = R[(i * 3 + leg) % R.length], prev = R[(i * 3 + leg - 1 + R.length * 1000) % R.length];
    var idle = (i % 11 === 0);
    if (idle) frac = 0.5;
    var path = road.path;
    if (leg % 2 === 1) path = path.slice().reverse();
    var p = this._point(path, frac);
    var id = 'VH-' + this._pad(i + 1);
    return {
      id: id, number: 'MIA-' + (100 + i + 1), lat: Math.round(p.lat * 1e6) / 1e6, lng: Math.round(p.lng * 1e6) / 1e6,
      road: road.name, speed: idle ? 0 : 25 + (i * 7) % 40, heading: p.heading, status: idle ? 'Idle' : 'Moving',
      timestamp: new GlideDateTime().getValue(), trip: { id: id + '-' + leg, from_road: prev.name, to_road: road.name }
    };
  },
  getPage: function(offset, limit) {
    offset = parseInt(offset, 10) || 0; limit = parseInt(limit, 10) || 20;
    var now = Math.floor(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() / 1000), out = [];
    for (var i = offset; i < Math.min(offset + limit, FleetSimulator.TOTAL); i++) out.push(this.vehicle(i, now));
    var nxt = offset + limit < FleetSimulator.TOTAL ? offset + limit : null;
    return { results: out, total: FleetSimulator.TOTAL, offset: offset, limit: limit, next: nxt };
  },
  type: 'FleetSimulator'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-15 20:03:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>2a92da44c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FleetSimulator</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Vehicle Tracking" source="x_189579_vtrack">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Vehicle Tracking">a4225204c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d9</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2a92da44c3cc1fd014d3b91ed40131d2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-15 20:03:57</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
